descriptions.text: Create incredible unique handmade cards with the Beauté abstraite Suite Collection. The suite collection is designed to make cardmaking quick and fun. The patterns in the suite include watercolor washes, splotches, brushstrokes and basic shapes so you can mix and match layer and repeat for an endless combination of designs. Skip some of the prep work with the preprinted Abstract Beauty Card & Envelopes. Use the Abstract Beauty Designer Series Paper and the Abstract Beauty Ephemera Pack for quick project elements. The basic shapes included in the Beautiful Shapes Dies can be used to cut out circle, hexagon, parallelogram, and triangle shapes from the paper for elements and embellishments, or use them to create tags and labels for your cards. The Bonjour ma cherie Stamp Set was designed to layer and repeat the images and includes a variety of all-occasion sayings. To top things off, add a little shimmer and shine with the Adhesive-Backed Hexagons. There is nothing abstract about how much fun you’ll have creating with this suite! Also available in English.

descriptions.text: Brighten someone's day with the Sunny Splash Stamp Set. Ink up one of these retro swimsuits for a solid image and pair it with a fun summertime message. Or use all four prints to create a versatile beachy background. Go for a two-toned look by getting out your markers and coloring directly on the stamp to create a print that's just your style. Dive deeper and try a new stamping technique. Mix and match swimsuit tops and bottoms by using the masking technique. Stamp the swim top of one image, cover with tracing paper so you can align the images, and then stamp the swim bottom you like. So many possibilities! Get creative with color and try for a soft gradient ombre look. Using a sponge, gradually fade from one color to another-like a fiery red and orange sunset or purple and blue magical mermaid moment.
